materials.name: Barbed Devil Hide
materials.desc: A leathery red hide studded with hooked barbs that tear at anything pressing against it. Armorers use it for punishing gauntlets and shield facings.

materials.name: Barbed Devil Spines
materials.desc: Finger-long spines that still smoulder faintly at the tips. They ignite when thrown hard, a trick fletchers try to copy.

materials.name: Barbed Devil Eye
materials.desc: An amber eye with a slit pupil that sees through magical murk as well as plain darkness. Sentries' lenses and darkvision draughts use it.

materials.name: Barbed Devil Essence
materials.desc: A prickling ember of hellish vigilance that seems to watch whoever holds the vessel.

materials.name: Bearded Devil Beard
materials.desc: A bundle of wiry, snake-like tendrils that twitch and ooze venom long after they are shorn. Poisoners render it into pastes that sicken the victim and keep wounds from closing.

materials.name: Bearded Devil Ichor
materials.desc: Thin, rust-coloured ichor that smells of hot iron and makes the skin crawl. A staple of fear-draughts and battle-rage tinctures.

materials.name: Bearded Devil Essence
materials.desc: A stubborn, bristling spark of soldierly obedience that refuses to be cowed by charms or terror.

materials.name: Bone Devil Stinger
materials.desc: A long, ivory-hard tail spike with a channel for venom. Makes a vicious spearhead or dagger blade.

materials.name: Bone Devil Venom
materials.desc: Sluggish yellow venom that burns like cold fire in the blood and saps the strength of its victim.

materials.name: Bone Devil Plates
materials.desc: Pale, ridged bone plates stretched with parchment-dry skin. Light, brutally hard, and cold to the touch - ideal for armor inlays.

materials.name: Bone Devil Wing
materials.desc: A tattered leathery wing strung over long finger-bones, still twitching when cut free.

materials.name: Bone Devil Essence
materials.desc: A cold, scheming mote that flickers in and out of sight inside its vessel.

materials.name: Chain Devil Chains
materials.desc: Barbed black chain that still coils and twitches as if seeking a limb to wrap. Enchanters bind animation and restraint magic into it.

materials.name: Chain Devil Visage
materials.desc: The flayed skin of its face, which ripples between the features of people you have lost. Mask-makers and illusionists covet it.

materials.name: Chain Devil Essence
materials.desc: A tight, clinking knot of malice that pulls at the vessel's stopper like a chain drawn taut.

materials.name: Erinyes Feather
materials.desc: A glossy feather black as a starless night, edged with a razor fringe. Prized for fletching and for wings of flying.

materials.name: Erinyes Blood
materials.desc: Dark blood that the erinyes coats her blades with; it fouls wounds and weakens the victim for hours.

materials.name: Erinyes Eye
materials.desc: A burning violet eye that pierces illusion, invisibility and shapechange alike. Among the finest truesight reagents in the lower planes.

materials.name: Erinyes Essence
materials.desc: A cold, righteous fury that circles the vessel like a bird of prey, straining after the nearest liar.

materials.name: Hell Hound Fire Gland
materials.desc: A fist-sized, pulsing sac beneath the throat, warm as a coal and slick with oily secretions. The heart of alchemist's fire and fire-breath draughts.

materials.name: Hell Hound Pelt
materials.desc: Coarse black fur that is always warm and never burns. A classic lining for fire-resistant cloaks.

materials.name: Hell Hound Fang
materials.desc: A soot-blackened fang with a faint glow at the root; it heats when the bearer is angry.

materials.name: Hell Hound Nose
materials.desc: A leathery, ever-damp nose that can pick out a trail through smoke. Trackers' charms and scenting oils use it.

materials.name: Hell Hound Essence
materials.desc: A panting, snapping flame that flares whenever the vessel is turned toward prey.

materials.name: Horned Devil Horn
materials.desc: A massive, ridged horn that smells of scorched stone. Ground to powder it feeds hurled-flame magic; whole, it becomes war horns and hilts.

materials.name: Horned Devil Tail Barb
materials.desc: A hooked tail barb whose wounds bleed and bleed. Weapon-smiths bind it into blades of wounding.

materials.name: Horned Devil Wing
materials.desc: A broad, scarred wing of red leather stretched over thick bone.

materials.name: Horned Devil Essence
materials.desc: A heavy, smouldering presence that makes the vessel feel twice its weight.

materials.name: Ice Devil Carapace
materials.desc: Blue-white chitin rimed with frost that never melts, hard as steel and cold enough to burn. Armorers work it into frost-proof plate.

materials.name: Ice Devil Mandible
materials.desc: A serrated, frosted mandible that frosts the air around it. Makes a terrifying blade.

materials.name: Ice Devil Frost Ichor
materials.desc: Pale blue ichor that freezes anything it touches into brittle crystal. Used for walls of ice and cold-cone wands.

materials.name: Ice Devil Tail
materials.desc: A long, spiked tail whose sting numbs and slows the struck limb.

materials.name: Ice Devil Essence
materials.desc: A still, frozen calculation that coats the vessel in frost within seconds.

materials.name: Imp Stinger
materials.desc: A needle-thin tail barb that still weeps a drop of venom. Favoured for poisoned darts.

materials.name: Imp Wing
materials.desc: A tiny, veined bat-wing, light as paper and hot to the touch.

materials.name: Imp Tongue
materials.desc: A forked, silver-tipped tongue. Pickled, it is said to lend a liar's fluency to anyone who keeps it under the pillow.

materials.name: Imp Essence
materials.desc: A jittery flicker that turns transparent, then rat-shaped, then transparent again inside its vessel.

materials.name: Lemure Sludge
materials.desc: A heavy, oily muck that crawls back toward itself if spilled. Alchemists use it to coax mending into salves.

materials.name: Pit Fiend Scale
materials.desc: A crimson scale the size of a palm, glowing faintly from within like iron fresh from the forge. The ultimate in fire-proof armor.

materials.name: Pit Fiend Fang
materials.desc: A curved fang with a venom groove that still sizzles. Blades made from it poison and burn in one stroke.

materials.name: Pit Fiend Wing
materials.desc: A vast wing that can be wrapped around the body like a cloak; its shadow alone makes lesser folk tremble.

materials.name: Pit Fiend Heart
materials.desc: A heart like a furnace-coal that beats on for minutes after death, exhaling a haze of terror. One of the most coveted reagents in any plane.

materials.name: Pit Fiend Essence
materials.desc: A crushing, regal malevolence that bends the will of anyone who stares into the vessel too long.

materials.name: Balor Heart-Coal
materials.desc: A heart burned down to a glowing black coal in the death-blast, still radiating murderous heat.

materials.name: Balor Horn
materials.desc: A colossal, scorched horn that thrums with rage. Carved into war horns, it spreads terror across a battlefield.

materials.name: Balor Wing Membrane
materials.desc: Charred wing leather that still smokes but never burns through. Fire-walkers' cloaks are made from it.

materials.name: Balor Death-Cinder
materials.desc: Glittering black ash from the balor's death explosion. Powders of it make fireballs hungrier and flames harder to put out.

materials.name: Balor Essence
materials.desc: A roaring whirl of flame and hatred that makes the vessel glow cherry-red.

materials.name: Dretch Stench Gland
materials.desc: A rubbery, grey-green sac that reeks of rotting eggs. Squeezed, it releases a nauseating cloud; stink bombs start here.

materials.name: Dretch Ichor
materials.desc: Brackish, bubbling ichor. The cheapest abyssal reagent there is, used as a base for fiendish inks.

materials.name: Glabrezu Pincer
materials.desc: A huge crab-like pincer that can snap a man in half. Smiths turn it into crushing gauntlets and siege tools.

materials.name: Glabrezu Hide
materials.desc: Thick, pebbled hide the colour of old blood. Tough enough for heavy leather armor.

materials.name: Glabrezu Tongue
materials.desc: A long, honey-sweet tongue that has spoken a thousand bargains. Its magic lends persuasion and deceit.

materials.name: Glabrezu Essence
materials.desc: A soft, whispering temptation that suggests what you might wish for if you only opened the vessel.

materials.name: Hezrou Stench Gland
materials.desc: A slimy, swollen musk sac whose reek clings for days. Refined, it makes potent stinking clouds and nauseating poisons.

materials.name: Hezrou Hide
materials.desc: Warty, rubbery hide that shrugs off acid and grime. Hard to work, harder to cut.

materials.name: Hezrou Claw
materials.desc: A thick, yellowed claw coated in a slime that never quite washes off.

materials.name: Hezrou Essence
materials.desc: A foul, gurgling fog that stains the inside of the vessel green.

materials.name: Marilith Scales
materials.desc: Glossy green-black serpent scales that seem to shift a hair ahead of the eye. Armor made from them turns aside blows before they land.

materials.name: Marilith Tail Sinew
materials.desc: Coils of steel-strong sinew from the constricting tail. Bowstrings and binding cords of it never slacken.

materials.name: Marilith Hand
materials.desc: One of six slender hands, still twitching toward a blade grip. Used in charms of quickness and parrying.

materials.name: Marilith Essence
materials.desc: A coiling, calculating essence that anticipates every movement of the vessel's holder.

materials.name: Nalfeshnee Tusk
materials.desc: A yellowed, curling tusk as long as a forearm. Carved into hilts, it lends a savage strength.

materials.name: Nalfeshnee Hide
materials.desc: A vast, bristled hide heavy with fat. Tanned, it resists fire, cold and lightning alike.

materials.name: Nalfeshnee Wing
materials.desc: A laughably small feathered wing that nevertheless tugs at space itself; the demon's teleportation is thought to lodge here.

materials.name: Nalfeshnee Essence
materials.desc: A shimmering rainbow nimbus that fills onlookers with dread.

materials.name: Quasit Claw
materials.desc: A tiny hooked claw that injects a weakening poison. Good for poisoned needles and pins.

materials.name: Quasit Horn
materials.desc: A little spiral horn that makes people nervous for reasons they can't name.

materials.name: Quasit Essence
materials.desc: A squirming, shape-shifting mote that alternates between toad, bat and nothing at all.

materials.name: Vrock Feathers
materials.desc: Greasy, blood-crusted vulture feathers that smell of carrion. Fletching of them flies true through storms.

materials.name: Vrock Spores
materials.desc: A fine, choking green dust shaken from the vrock's feathers. The spores sprout into tendrils in living flesh.

materials.name: Vrock Screech Organ
materials.desc: A bellows-like voice box that can still loose a dying wail. Horns of blasting and stunning charms use it.

materials.name: Vrock Essence
materials.desc: A shrieking, feathery storm that rattles the vessel.

materials.name: Night Hag Heartstone
materials.desc: A lustrous black gem that grants its bearer passage to the Ethereal Plane and wards against every disease. It is the night hag's greatest treasure.

materials.name: Night Hag Soul Bag
materials.desc: A pouch sewn from flayed hide that can hold a trapped soul. Necromancers and soul-freeing clerics both seek it.

materials.name: Night Hag Eye
materials.desc: A milky eye that stares past walls and into dreams. The classic ingredient for scrying charms.

materials.name: Night Hag Fingernails
materials.desc: Long, yellow-grey nails that ache when anyone nearby is dreaming. Used in curse rituals and nightmare bindings.

materials.name: Night Hag Essence
materials.desc: A ragged smoke of stolen dreams that slips half out of reality when disturbed.

materials.name: Nightmare Mane
materials.desc: Hair that burns endlessly with a low, smokeless flame without being consumed. Woven into ropes and tassels for fire magic and planar travel.

materials.name: Nightmare Hooves
materials.desc: Smouldering black hooves that leave scorched prints. Horseshoes forged with them lend a charger speed and a burning trail.

materials.name: Nightmare Hide
materials.desc: Smoke-black horsehide that feels warm through thick gloves.

materials.name: Nightmare Essence
materials.desc: A galloping shadow wreathed in flame that fades in and out of the Ethereal as you watch.

materials.name: Rakshasa Claw
materials.desc: A hooked claw whose scratches rot the victim's mind with a curse that only powerful magic can lift. Blades made from it carry the curse.

materials.name: Rakshasa Hide
materials.desc: Striped tiger hide that lesser spells slide off like rain. Cloaks of it are coveted by mage-hunters.

materials.name: Rakshasa Whiskers
materials.desc: Stiff, silver whiskers that quiver near falsehood. Illusionists use them as foci for disguises.

materials.name: Rakshasa Essence
materials.desc: A purring, velvet deception that looks like whatever the viewer most wants to see.

materials.name: Succubus/Incubus Wing
materials.desc: A sleek, velvet-soft bat wing of deep crimson. Lightweight flying cloaks and charms use it.

materials.name: Succubus/Incubus Lips
materials.desc: Full, warm lips that still tempt to be kissed. Rendered into balms of allure and life-draining poisons.

materials.name: Succubus/Incubus Hair
materials.desc: A lock of hair that changes colour to suit whoever looks at it. A favourite of love-charm makers and disguise kits.

materials.name: Succubus/Incubus Essence
materials.desc: A sweet, heady haze that whispers promises and takes on a beloved face.

materials.name: Couatl Feather
materials.desc: A jewel-bright feather of emerald and gold that drifts upward when dropped. Prized for flight charms and holy fletching.

materials.name: Couatl Scale
materials.desc: A small iridescent scale that warms at the touch of the faithful. Used in protective amulets.

materials.name: Couatl Venom
materials.desc: Clear, faintly glowing venom that brings a deep, merciful sleep rather than death.

materials.name: Couatl Essence
materials.desc: A calm, patient light that speaks directly into the mind of whoever holds the vessel.

materials.name: Deva Feather
materials.desc: A shed feather of soft silver that glows faintly in darkness. Among the finest feathers for flying and blessing magic.

materials.name: Deva Radiant Tears
materials.desc: Tears of liquid light that heal wounds and banish sickness. Holy healers treasure a single vial above gold.

materials.name: Deva Halo-Essence
materials.desc: A fading halo of pure warmth that makes the vessel ring softly like a bell.

materials.name: Planetar Feather
materials.desc: A long, snow-white feather that never dirties. Weaves into wings and cloaks of glorious flight.

materials.name: Planetar Radiant Tears
materials.desc: Glowing emerald tears said to restore even lost limbs.

materials.name: Planetar Eye
materials.desc: An eye of blazing gold that sees all lies and disguises. Removing it is considered sacrilege by most churches.

materials.name: Planetar Halo-Essence
materials.desc: A steady, just radiance that makes lies painful to speak near the vessel.

materials.name: Solar Feather
materials.desc: A golden feather that shines like a sunrise. A single one can light a cathedral.

materials.name: Solar Radiant Tears
materials.desc: Tears of molten sunlight said to be able to call back a soul from death.

materials.name: Solar Light-Mote
materials.desc: A crystallized fragment of the solar's glory, glowing with a warm, unending light that burns undead.

materials.name: Solar Halo-Essence
materials.desc: A blinding, holy radiance that forces anyone evil to look away.

materials.name: Pegasus Feather
materials.desc: A soft white feather that drifts upward in still air. A cheap and common flight reagent.

materials.name: Pegasus Flight Feather
materials.desc: One of the long primary feathers from the wing tip, stiff and strong. The core of many flying mounts' saddles and flying potions.

materials.name: Pegasus Mane
materials.desc: Silky white horsehair that never tangles. Used in bowstrings and charms of swiftness.

materials.name: Pegasus Essence
materials.desc: A bright, soaring essence that tugs the vessel upward.

materials.name: Unicorn Horn
materials.desc: A spiral horn of pearl-white ivory that purifies poison and heals by touch. Legendary in lore; nearly priceless to the faithful.

materials.name: Unicorn Tears
materials.desc: A few drops of shimmering liquid that close wounds and cure disease. Priceless for healing draughts.

materials.name: Unicorn Mane
materials.desc: Silver-white horsehair that repels evil spirits. Woven into cords and wards.

materials.name: Unicorn Hooves
materials.desc: Gleaming, pearl-like hooves that leave no tracks on moss.

materials.name: Unicorn Essence
materials.desc: A gentle, blinding purity that makes the vessel feel impossibly clean.

materials.name: Blink Dog Pelt
materials.desc: Tawny fur that flickers slightly at the edges of vision. Used in cloaks and boots of blinking.

materials.name: Blink Dog Fang
materials.desc: A small fang that is never quite where you left it.

materials.name: Blink Dog Essence
materials.desc: A flickering, playful essence that seems to jump from one side of the vessel to the other.

materials.name: Dryad Heartwood
materials.desc: A living piece of the dryad's bound tree, still pulsing with green life. Druids' staffs and charms of growth use it.

materials.name: Dryad Hair
materials.desc: A lock of leafy hair that changes colour with the seasons. Love-charms and friendship tokens use it.

materials.name: Dryad Sap
materials.desc: A sweet, golden sap that smells of honey and fresh rain. Charm potions start here.

materials.name: Dryad Essence
materials.desc: A soft green glimmer that drifts toward the nearest tree.

materials.name: Green Hag Eye
materials.desc: A murky green eye that sees through tricks and disguises. The scrying eye of a hag coven.

materials.name: Green Hag Fingernails
materials.desc: Long, algae-green fingernails that fester any wound they scratch. Curse-makers value them.

materials.name: Green Hag Tongue
materials.desc: A slimy tongue that can mimic any voice it has heard. Used in mimicry charms and ventriloquist tricks.

materials.name: Green Hag Essence
materials.desc: A cackling, shifting fog that looks like a different thing every time you glance at it.

materials.name: Sea Hag Hair
materials.desc: A tangle of wet, seaweed-like hair that never dries. Used in curses of drowning and nightmares of the sea.

materials.name: Sea Hag Eye
materials.desc: A bulging, fish-like eye that retains a shred of the hag's death glare. Dangerous to carry.

materials.name: Sea Hag Scales
materials.desc: Slimy, barnacled scales scraped from her arms. Used in potions of water breathing and swimming.

materials.name: Sea Hag Essence
materials.desc: A murky, brackish essence that looks like a hideous face pressed against the glass.

materials.name: Satyr Horn
materials.desc: A small curled horn that hums when music is played nearby. Instrument makers use it for enchanted pipes.

materials.name: Satyr Fleece
materials.desc: Curly fleece from the goatish legs that resists spells faintly. Used in cloaks against magic.

materials.name: Satyr Essence
materials.desc: A merry, tipsy essence that hums a tune inside its vessel.

materials.name: Sprite Wings
materials.desc: A pair of dragonfly-like wings that fade from sight when held still. A key reagent for dust of disappearance.

materials.name: Sprite Sleep Poison
materials.desc: A drop of clear poison from the sprite's quiver, sending the victim into a gentle, dreamless sleep.

materials.name: Sprite Essence
materials.desc: A tiny, sparkling mote that sees into the heart of whoever looks at it.

monsters.name: Barbed Devil
monsters.blurb: A hunched sentry of the Hells bristling with hooked spines, whose very skin punishes anyone who grapples it.

harvest.note: Slain outside the Hells, the carcass slumps into reeking brimstone within 1 minute; work fast. Heavy gloves required; a failed check deals 1d10 piercing damage to the harvester.
Pull them against the hook or they snap and lose their heat.
Speak no names while you work: the essence listens. Seal it within a minute.

monsters.name: Bearded Devil
monsters.blurb: A shock-trooper of the Hells whose writhing, venomous beard is as dangerous as its saw-toothed glaive.

harvest.note: Slain outside the Hells, the carcass slumps into reeking brimstone within 1 minute; work fast. The tendrils still bite: DC 12 Constitution save or be poisoned for 1 minute.
It rises as a stinking smoke from the wounds. Cap the Essence Vessel over it within a minute.

monsters.name: Bone Devil
monsters.blurb: A skeletal taskmaster of the Hells with bat wings and a scorpion tail, cruel and patient in equal measure.

harvest.note: Slain outside the Hells, the carcass slumps into reeking brimstone within 1 minute; work fast.
Milk the sac before the tail stiffens; rupturing it (fail by 5+) exposes you to the poison.
Speak no names while you work: the essence listens. Seal it within a minute.

monsters.name: Chain Devil
monsters.blurb: A torturer wrapped in hooked chains it can animate at will, wearing a mask of whoever its victim loves most.

harvest.note: The chains are part of the devil; they stop moving and rust to flakes if not quenched in salt water within 1 hour.

Slain outside the Hells, the carcass slumps into reeking brimstone within 1 minute; work fast. Whoever cuts it free sees a loved one's face staring back; DC 14 Wisdom save or be frightened for 1 minute.
Speak no names while you work: the essence listens. Seal it within a minute.

monsters.name: Erinyes
monsters.blurb: A winged avenger of the Hells, beautiful and relentless, who hunts oath-breakers with poisoned blades and truesight.

harvest.note: Slain outside the Hells, the carcass slumps into reeking brimstone within 1 minute; work fast.
Remove with a silver spoon; iron blades cloud the lens.
It tries to slip home to its plane. Seal it in an Essence Vessel within a minute, and never hold the vessel bare-handed.

monsters.name: Hell Hound
monsters.blurb: A black-furred hound of the lower planes that hunts in packs and belches gouts of fire.

harvest.note: Keep it cool and sealed; if punctured (fail by 5+) it bursts for 2d6 fire damage.
Unlike most fiends, a hell hound's body lingers for hours before crumbling to ash.
It rises as a stinking smoke from the wounds. Cap the Essence Vessel over it within a minute.

monsters.name: Horned Devil
monsters.blurb: A winged brute of the Hells armed with a fork and a barbed tail that leaves wounds that will not close.

harvest.note: Slain outside the Hells, the carcass slumps into reeking brimstone within 1 minute; work fast. The horns survive the dissolution if hacked off at the base.
It rises as a stinking smoke from the wounds. Cap the Essence Vessel over it within a minute.

monsters.name: Ice Devil
monsters.blurb: An insectile giant of the frozen Hells whose touch and tail freeze flesh solid.

harvest.note: Slain outside the Hells, the carcass slumps into reeking brimstone within 1 minute; work fast. Pry the plates loose before they sublimate into freezing mist.
Collect in a warmed vessel or it freezes solid and shatters.
It rises as a stinking smoke from the wounds. Cap the Essence Vessel over it within a minute.

monsters.name: Imp
monsters.blurb: A tiny, spiteful devil prized by warlocks as a familiar, able to vanish or take the shape of a rat, raven or spider.

harvest.note: Slain outside the Hells, the carcass slumps into reeking brimstone within 1 minute; work fast.
It tries to slip home to its plane. Seal it in an Essence Vessel within a minute, and never hold the vessel bare-handed.

monsters.name: Lemure
monsters.blurb: A mindless, molten blob of damned soul-stuff that shambles across the Hells and re-forms if not properly destroyed.

harvest.note: Only sludge from a lemure slain with holy water or a blessed weapon stays inert; otherwise it slithers away overnight.

monsters.name: Pit Fiend
monsters.blurb: A general of the Nine Hells, cloaked in wings and radiating dread, whose bite carries a burning venom.

harvest.note: Slain outside the Hells, the carcass slumps into reeking brimstone within 1 minute; work fast.
Must be removed before the body dissolves; anyone within 10 feet during the cut must pass a DC 21 Wisdom save or be frightened.

It tries to slip home to its plane. Seal it in an Essence Vessel within a minute, and never hold the vessel bare-handed. Unless the vessel is etched with holy symbols, the essence cracks it within a day.

monsters.name: Balor
monsters.blurb: A towering demon of flame and shadow wielding a lightning sword and a fiery whip, which explodes in fire when it dies.

harvest.note: The balor explodes in fire on death; only the heart-coal and cinders survive. Tongs of cold iron and a lead-lined box are essential.
Blasted loose by the death-throes; search the blast zone before the ichor claims it.
Slain off the Abyss, the body boils away into black ichor within 1 minute; only what you cut free in time remains.
Speak no names while you work: the essence listens. Seal it within a minute. The essence tries to escape with the death-blast; DC 22 Dexterity check to cap the vessel in time.

monsters.name: Dretch
monsters.blurb: A pot-bellied, miserable demonling that fights in swarms and can belch forth a cloud of choking stench.

harvest.note: Slain off the Abyss, the body boils away into black ichor within 1 minute; only what you cut free in time remains. Bursting it (fail by 5+) poisons you until the end of your next turn.

monsters.name: Glabrezu
monsters.blurb: A dog-headed demon with crushing pincers, infamous for tempting mortals with granted wishes.

harvest.note: Slain off the Abyss, the body boils away into black ichor within 1 minute; only what you cut free in time remains.
It tries to slip home to its plane. Seal it in an Essence Vessel within a minute, and never hold the vessel bare-handed.

monsters.name: Hezrou
monsters.blurb: A toad-like demon brute whose stench is so foul it can sicken foes before they close to melee.

harvest.note: Slain off the Abyss, the body boils away into black ichor within 1 minute; only what you cut free in time remains. Handle while holding your breath; failing by 5+ leaves you poisoned for an hour.
It tries to slip home to its plane. Seal it in an Essence Vessel within a minute, and never hold the vessel bare-handed.

monsters.name: Marilith
monsters.blurb: A six-armed serpent demon and master tactician whose blades are always where you do not want them.

harvest.note: Slain off the Abyss, the body boils away into black ichor within 1 minute; only what you cut free in time remains.
It rises as a stinking smoke from the wounds. Cap the Essence Vessel over it within a minute.

monsters.name: Nalfeshnee
monsters.blurb: A bloated boar-headed demon with absurdly small wings that can teleport and project a nimbus of horror.

harvest.note: Slain off the Abyss, the body boils away into black ichor within 1 minute; only what you cut free in time remains.
It tries to slip home to its plane. Seal it in an Essence Vessel within a minute, and never hold the vessel bare-handed.

monsters.name: Quasit
monsters.blurb: A tiny, hateful demon familiar that turns invisible and slips between the shapes of bat, centipede and toad.

harvest.note: Slain off the Abyss, the body boils away into black ichor within 1 minute; only what you cut free in time remains.
It rises as a stinking smoke from the wounds. Cap the Essence Vessel over it within a minute.

monsters.name: Vrock
monsters.blurb: A vulture-like demon that releases clouds of poisonous spores and shrieks to stun its enemies.

harvest.note: Slain off the Abyss, the body boils away into black ichor within 1 minute; only what you cut free in time remains.
Wear a mask; failing by 5+ exposes you to the spores (DC 14 Constitution save).
Speak no names while you work: the essence listens. Seal it within a minute.

monsters.name: Night Hag
monsters.blurb: A fiendish hag that rides the dreams of sleepers, trading in souls with the help of her heartstone and soul bag.

harvest.note: Found among her belongings, never inside her. If she died in ethereal form, the gem is lost with her. Destroyed if struck by a protection from evil spell.
If it holds a soul, most temples insist on freeing it rather than selling it.
It tries to slip home to its plane. Seal it in an Essence Vessel within a minute, and never hold the vessel bare-handed.

monsters.name: Nightmare
monsters.blurb: A black steed with a burning mane and hooves that can carry its rider through the Ethereal Plane.

harvest.note: Cut it while the fire still burns; if it goes out, it is only coarse black hair.
Speak no names while you work: the essence listens. Seal it within a minute.

monsters.name: Rakshasa
monsters.blurb: A tiger-headed fiend with backward hands, a master of illusion whose hide shrugs off most spells.

harvest.note: A slain rakshasa reforms in the Hells; its body dissolves into brimstone in 1 minute. Handle the claws with gloves: a scratch curses the harvester.
Must be flayed in one piece within the minute before dissolution; a blade blessed by a priest is required to cut it.
It tries to slip home to its plane. Seal it in an Essence Vessel within a minute, and never hold the vessel bare-handed.

monsters.name: Succubus/Incubus
monsters.blurb: A shapechanging fiend that seduces mortals, draining life with a kiss and corrupting souls through dreams.

harvest.note: The body melts to perfumed smoke within 1 minute when slain off its home plane.
It rises as a stinking smoke from the wounds. Cap the Essence Vessel over it within a minute.

monsters.name: Couatl
monsters.blurb: A feathered serpent of the gods, a wise guardian that can shape-shift and speak mind-to-mind.

harvest.note: Harvesting a celestial is a grave act; good-aligned deities and their clergy may take offense. Shed feathers can sometimes be gathered from a living couatl's lair (DC 13 Nature) without offense.
Catch the glow in an Essence Vessel before it fades upward. Many deities would call this sacrilege.

monsters.name: Deva
monsters.blurb: An angelic messenger of the gods, beautiful and radiant, whose touch can heal and whose mace strikes with holy light.

harvest.note: Harvesting a celestial is a grave act; good-aligned deities and their clergy may take offense. Shed feathers sometimes remain where a deva once stood; these carry no taint.
Collected from a fallen deva as its light fades. Harvesting a celestial is a grave act; good-aligned deities and their clergy may take offense.
It rises as a soft light within a minute of death. Harvesting a celestial is a grave act; good-aligned clergy may take offence.

monsters.name: Planetar
monsters.blurb: A towering angelic warrior, emerald-skinned and white-winged, who serves as the sword of the gods.

harvest.note: Harvesting a celestial is a grave act; good-aligned deities and their clergy may take offense.
Gathered as the planetar's light fades. Harvesting a celestial is a grave act; good-aligned deities and their clergy may take offense.
Harvesting a celestial is a grave act; good-aligned deities and their clergy may take offense.
It rises as a soft light within a minute of death. Harvesting a celestial is a grave act; good-aligned clergy may take offence.

monsters.name: Solar
monsters.blurb: The mightiest of angels, whose golden glory is matched only by its terrible power to smite evil.

harvest.note: Harvesting a celestial is a grave act; good-aligned deities and their clergy may take offense. Only a single shed feather is typically found; the rest crumble to motes of light.
A fallen solar sheds only a few drops as it fades. Harvesting a celestial is a grave act; good-aligned deities and their clergy may take offense.
Harvesting a celestial is a grave act; good-aligned deities and their clergy may take offense.
It rises as a soft light within a minute of death. Harvesting a celestial is a grave act; good-aligned clergy may take offence.

monsters.name: Pegasus
monsters.blurb: A winged white horse of the heavens that serves only the good-hearted.

harvest.note: Shed feathers can be collected near pegasus aeries without harm to the herd.
Harvesting a celestial is a grave act; good-aligned deities and their clergy may take offense.
It rises as a soft light within a minute of death. Harvesting a celestial is a grave act; good-aligned clergy may take offence.

monsters.name: Unicorn
monsters.blurb: A shining white horse with a spiral horn, guardian of sacred groves, able to heal and to teleport.

harvest.note: Must be freely given by a unicorn, or taken from one that fell naturally. A horn stolen by killing turns cursed: it brings misfortune and cannot heal.
Harvesting a celestial is a grave act; good-aligned deities and their clergy may take offense.
A unicorn may offer a lock of its mane to a worthy friend; taking it otherwise angers the forest.
Harvesting a celestial is a grave act; good-aligned deities and their clergy may take offense.
Catch the glow in an Essence Vessel before it fades upward. Many deities would call this sacrilege.

monsters.name: Blink Dog
monsters.blurb: A clever yellow-furred dog of the Feywild that blinks in and out of existence as it hunts.

harvest.note: Blink dogs are friends to the good folk of the Feywild; wearing its pelt openly there invites trouble.
Needs an Essence Vessel within 1 minute of death; stopper it fast, for it keeps trying to blink out of the glass.

monsters.name: Dryad
monsters.blurb: A tree spirit bound to a single oak, able to charm travellers and step from tree to tree.

harvest.note: Only obtainable from her bound tree, and only after she has died. Cutting it from a living dryad's tree slays her and curses the cutter.
Needs an Essence Vessel within 1 minute of death, before it seeps away into her bound tree.

monsters.name: Green Hag
monsters.blurb: A wicked hag of swamps and forests who uses illusion and mimicry to lure victims.

harvest.note: If she belonged to a coven, her eyes may already have been made into a hag eye; take it from her neck.
A faint shimmer over the body marks it. Catch it in an Essence Vessel within a minute.

monsters.name: Sea Hag
monsters.blurb: A hideous hag of the shallows whose appearance alone can frighten, and whose glare can stop a heart.

harvest.note: Cover it at once; anyone meeting its stare while harvesting must pass a DC 11 Wisdom save or be frightened for 1 minute.
It escapes with the last breath: hold an Essence Vessel ready and stopper it within a minute.

monsters.name: Satyr
monsters.blurb: A goat-legged reveler of the Feywild, fond of music and trickery and hard for magic to touch.

harvest.note: Needs an Essence Vessel within 1 minute of death; it drifts toward any music, so harvest in silence.

monsters.name: Sprite
monsters.blurb: A tiny winged fey warrior who can turn invisible and shoots arrows tipped with sleep poison.

harvest.note: Most fey courts consider it murder to harvest a sprite; expect retribution in the Feywild.
Collected from arrows as well as the body.
Needs an Essence Vessel within 1 minute of death; it scatters like pollen in the faintest breeze.
